curation.name: Roller Blade Crouch Glide
curation.summary: Aerodynamic tuck crouch maneuver while coasting on roller skates, lowering center of gravity for high-speed stability.
curation.details: Publisher materials describe a short phase-driven tuck gesture for the roller configuration.
curation.notes: Publisher hardware and command claims are not independent registry evidence.
